notes.title: SAD RPG - our new game!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=aoBaY6dQq2k;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3][b]
Hello simple office clerks![/b][/h3]

[b]11 - 11 - 2021 we released “SAD RPG : A Social Anxiety Role Playing Game” on Steam Early Access and it’s ready to be played, tested, loved or hated! 
Join us on a surprisingly colorful, weird and full of surprises journey through reality which is a metaphorical fight with social anxiety disorder.
Download the game and let us know what you think - all suggestions, comments, opinions matter for us and are more than welcome - please, share them. You are important :) [/b]

[b]DISCLAIMER: [/b]Be mindful that SAD RPG is still in active development and we will actively work on game updates during the Steam Early Access in 2021/2022.

[h3][b]SAD RPG Steam Early Access features and informations:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] first person perspective
[*] modern day setting
[*] skills development
[*] turn-based anti-anxiety combat
[*] save/load system (in Options menu)
[*] unique graphic
[*] unique soundtrack
[*] story about social anxiety disorder
[*] educational elements
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/22314628/c31bdec3bf4bbc8d890286e6eff212314816f6e8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/22314628/63cc9fd220e265a7ed16945912d38b4566759e16.png[/img]

[b]SAD RPG : A Social Anxiety Role Playing Game[/b] is an experimental indie computer RPG game about social anxiety. 
It's an unexpectedly colourful, weird and full of surprises journey with our own story about dealing with Social Anxiety Disorder.

We are still working on [b]SAD RPG[/b] and plan to provide weekly updates with new content, gameplay improvements and bug fixes. 

We are very curious about your feedback, opinions and overall reception of our game. 
You can contact us on [url=https://discord.gg/uZRQAYU]SAD RPG Discord Server[/url].


[h3]If you like the concept of [b]SAD RPG[/b] or it seems interesting to you, you can play Early Access version on Steam now: [/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/857760/SAD_RPG_A_Social_Anxiety_Role_Playing_Game/

[b]Take care!

Evil Indie Games[/b]

notes.title: NO THING & SAD RPG
notes.content:
[b]Hello simple office clerks!

It's been a long time since the last transmission from broken future of year 1994.

Because of important events in real life we were silent, but here we come back[/b].

On behalf of Her Majesty the Queen of Ice, we have the honor and responsibility to announce that we are working on a new [b]SAD RPG[/b] game in which you will find lots of references to [b]NO THING[/b].

[previewyoutube=BcLAjqrEE9k;full][/previewyoutube]

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/857760/SAD_RPG_A_Social_Anxiety_Role_Playing_Game/]SAD RPG : A Social Anxiety Role Playing Game[/url][/b] is an experimental indie computer RPG game about social anxiety. 
It's an unexpectedly colourful, weird and full of surprises journey with our own story about dealing with Social Anxiety Disorder.

[h3]Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] first person perspective 
[*] modern day setting
[*] skills development
[*] non-linear storyline
[*] open world quests
[*] turn-based, tactical anti-anxiety combat
[*] unique graphic
[*] unique soundtrack
[*] story about social anxiety disorder
[/list]


We are still working on [b]SAD RPG[/b] and plan to release it in Early Access in the near future. 
We are very curious about your feedback, opinions and overall reception of our game. 
You can contact us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/uZRQAYU]SAD RPG Discord Server[/url].


[b]If you like the concept of SAD RPG or it seems interesting to you, please add our game to your wishlist: [/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/857760/SAD_RPG_A_Social_Anxiety_Role_Playing_Game/
